result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.add_node()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add a node to the graph with optional connections and attributes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L380-L497){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.add_node( label=None, type=None, from_node=None, to_node=None, **attributes ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} This method provides flexible node creation, allowing you to add isolated nodes, nodes with labels, or nodes that are immediately connected to existing nodes. Node IDs are 64-bit unsigned integers managed automatically by EdgeCase, while labels provide human-readable identifiers. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [label]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional string label for human-readable node access. Labels should be unique if you plan to use them for node lookup in operations like `add_edge()`. [type]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional string type classification for the node (e.g., 'user', 'admin', 'organization'). This is a first-class attribute that always appears as the third column in node DataFrames. [from_node]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[Union[int, str]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional node (ID or label) to connect FROM the new node. Creates a directed edge: `new_node -> from_node`. [to_node]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[Union[int, str]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional node (ID or label) to connect TO the new node. Creates a directed edge: `to_node -> new_node`. [**attributes]{.doc-parameter-name} : Arbitrary key-value pairs to store as node attributes. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Returns self to enable method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Add an isolated node with auto-generated ID: ::: {#f648e127 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph() graph.add_node(label="Node1") node_id = graph.get_id_from_label("Node1") graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` Number of nodes : 1 Number of edges : 0 Directed : False Density : 0.00 Average degree (min, max) : 0.00 (0, 0) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: ::: Add nodes with labels for easier reference: ::: {#d65aca58 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Alice") .add_node(label="Bob") .add_node(label="Charlie") ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 0 Directed : False Density : 0.00 Average degree (min, max) : 0.00 (0, 0) Connected : False Number of connected components : 3 Tree : False Bipartite : True ``` ::: ::: Create a node immediately connected to existing nodes: ::: {#f44299dd .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="Alice") .add_node(label="Bob", from_node="Alice") # Edge: Alice -> Bob .add_node(label="Charlie", to_node="Alice") # Edge: Charlie -> Alice ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 2 Directed : True Density : 0.33 Average degree (min, max) : 1.33 (1, 2) Strongly connected : False Weakly connected : True Number of strongly connected components : 3 Number of weakly connected components : 1 ``` ::: ::: Add nodes with custom attributes: ::: {#821a1e92 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Alice", age=30, role="engineer") .add_node(label="Bob", age=25, role="designer") ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` Number of nodes : 2 Number of edges : 0 Directed : False Density : 0.00 Average degree (min, max) : 0.00 (0, 0) Connected : False Number of connected components : 2 Tree : False Bipartite : True ``` ::: :::
